title: UAAP: Rookies push Adamson past La Salle, into women's badminton Final 4
summary: Adamson's rookies came up big on Wednesday as they scored a 5-0 sweep of De La Salle University in the UAAP Season 89 women's badminton tournament at the Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City.
